sentences.text: Since there is no one present to argue the matter on behalf of the revisionist, the matter is being decided with assistance of learned A.G.A. for the State and by perusing the trial court records.

5. The present revision under Sections 397/401 Cr.P.C. has been preferred by the revisionist Mehndi Hassan against the judgement and order dated 05.07.2008 passed by Additional Sessions Judge/Fast Track-I, Court No. 4, District J.P. Nagar, in Criminal Appeal No. 21 of 2006 by which the said appeal has been dismissed and the judgement and order dated 12.12.2006 passed by the trial court has been affirmed, and, further against the judgement and order dated 12.12.2006 passed by Chief Judicial Magistrate, District J.P. Nagar in Criminal Case No. 1938 of 1999, under Section 10/16 Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954, whereby the revisionist has been sentenced for 06 months rigorous imprisonment and a fine of Rs.1000/- and in default of payment of fine to further additional simple imprisonment of 01 month by recording conviction under Section 10/16(1)(C) of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954.
6.

entities.text: Additional Sessions Judge/Fast Track-I, Court No. 4, District J.P. Nagar
entities.label: COURT

entities.text: Chief Judicial Magistrate, District J.P. Nagar
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The present revision was admitted vide order dated 15.7.2008 and the revisionist was directed to be released on bail.
The amount of fine was not stayed which was directed to be paid by the revisionist.

7. The facts of the case are that the complainant Ram Prakash, Food Inspector, Zoya stopped the revisionist on 14.12.1991 at about 09:45 a.m. while he was carrying about 80 kilograms of milk in 04 containers which was intended for sale.

On suspicion of it being adulterated, he disclosed his identity to the accused and label, notice, receipt and code slip no. M.B.D.258 were prepared and asked the accused to give sample of the milk but the same was refused by him.
The accused took the government papers from the complainant and tore them and took them away abusing him.
The complainant then took sanction from the C.M.O. concerned and filed a complaint against the revisionist/accused.
In the trial court the complainant/Ram Prakash was examined as P.W.-1,
Pramod Kumar clerk was examined as P.W.-2, Om Prakash Sanitary Supervisor was examined as P.W.-3.
The accused/revisionist in his statement under Section 313 Cr.P.C. denied the prosecution case and stated of false implication.
No defense evidence was led.
The trial court convicted and sentenced the accused/revisionist as stated above.
The appeal was preferred against the same which came to be dismissed after which the present revision has been filed against both the impugned judgement and orders.

8. The records show that Ram Prakash prepared a note of the spot of which Om Prakash/P.W.-2 is a witness, which is Ext.Ka-1 to the records, the F.I.R. being Ext. Ka-3 has also exhibited which has been lodged by Ram Prakash against the accused for the offence under Sections 186, 504 I.P.C. at Police Station Dehat Amroha, District Moradabad.
The report of P.W.-1 Ram Prakash for lodging of the F.I.R. is Ext. Ka-2 to the records.
In so far as the entire documents are concerned the same would go to show that there is no public and independent witness of the entire incident as narrated.

The sanction to prosecute the accused/revisionist by the C.M.O. concerned has been accorded for the offences under Section 7/16 and 16(1)(C) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 whereas the complaint dated 21.12.1991 has been filed by P.W.-1 Ram Prakash for the offence under Section 16(1)(C) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954.
The place where the alleged incident is said to have taken place is a road described as Zoya Road, Chidiya Bagh, Amroha.

Despite Mehndi Hassan vs State Of U.P. on 3 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/146211343/
2 the same there is no independent witness to support the prosecution story.

sentences.text: Looking to the facts and circumstances of the case and the fact that despite the place being a road and a public place, there is no public and independent witness of the prosecution case and no sample was drawn which would go to show that there was some material being carried by the revisionist which could have been found to be within the purview of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act to be adulterated, misfit for human consumption or misbranded.
9. The present revision is allowed.

The impugned judgement and order dated 05.07.2008 passed by Additional Sessions Judge/Fast Track-I, Court No. 4, District J.P. Nagar, in Criminal Appeal No. 21 of 2006 and the impugned judgement and order dated 12.12.2006 passed by Chief Judicial Magistrate, District J.P. Nagar in Criminal Case No. 1938 of 1999 are hereby set aside.
10.

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The revisionist- Mehndi Hassan is acquitted of the charge levelled against him.
The revisionist is on bail.
His bail bond is cancelled and sureties discharged.
11. Office is directed to transmit the copy of this judgement along with the trial court records to the concerned trial court forthwith for its compliance and necessary action.
12. The file be consigned to records.
(Samit Gopal,J.) Order Date :- 3.10.2023
